algorithm: Frozen feedback-off native parent plus joint budget net sweep plus refreshed critical policy
implementation_selection: Implicit implementation only if all three development full-run trees, quality and complete recorded decision traces equal reference; otherwise retain reference and archive mismatch. No selection based on reserved outcomes.
architecture: Same controlled three-layer SB3/cw80 development architecture generation, no commercial SLR equivalence claim.
parent_configuration_rule: Copy frozen scalar configuration verbatim; only circuit/input identity, explicitly paired seed and output paths may differ. Archive effective command and environment.
baseline_policy: Fresh native VPR baseline for each circuit/seed under identical architecture,width,packing and placement inputs. Bind source/binary/commands/input graph and route hashes before candidate evaluation; include baseline failures.
failure_policy: Archive all attempts. Missing endpoint binding, exhausted labels, route/STA failure and native baseline failure are explicit outcomes. No omitted failures, case-specific caps, width changes, net IDs or post-result tuning.
timing_policy: Charge parent routing, graph loading, initial STA, every search, writeback, native validation, observations, binder and verification. Report explicit verification separately; hash preflight exclusion stated. Preserve per-stage and total wall time; no physical speedup from CPU timing.
launch_prerequisites: Full development implicit comparison independently reviewed or reference retained per predefined rule
Freeze generated architecture, native tools and effective per-seed baseline commands before candidate outcomes
Dedicated reserved run directories with immutable source and input manifests
claim_limits: No physical-board performance or energy inferred
Five seeds are distinct from identical-configuration repeats
No gate closes solely because this protocol exists
